collection.name: Game Servers
collection.description: Multiplayer dedicated game servers powered by SteamCMD and native game engines
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: Valheim
shard.description: Viking survival and exploration multiplayer dedicated server in a procedurally generated purgatory inspired by Norse mythology.
shard.author: Iron Gate Studio & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Valheim Dedicated Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/steamcmd
cd /tmp/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz"
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz

echo "Installing Valheim Dedicated Server (App ID 896660)..."
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 896660 validate +quit

cd /mnt/server
chmod +x valheim_server.x86_64
echo "Valheim installation complete!"
